answer_1.quote: We present a novel diffusion method for modeling languages... We perform experiments on E2E dataset and 5 controllable generation tasks including Semantic Content, Parts-of-speech, Syntax Tree, Syntax Spans, and Length.
answer_1.outputs: Generated sentences satisfying control conditions (e.g., specific semantic content, POS sequence, syntax structure, length)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the accuracy of the generated sentence by examine the exact match rate... and we use a teacher LM (i.e., a carefully fine-tuned GPT-2 model) and report the perplexity of generated text.

answer_4.quote: We then conduct human evaluation to evaluate the generated conversations qualitatively. We ask native speakers of English from Amazon Mechanical Turk to rank the quality of 50 generated sentences...
answer_4.guideline: annotators need to rank different system outputs based on the (i) fluency (whether the given sentence is readable and fluent) and (ii) the controllability (whether the given sentence match the given control conditions)
